content: Bab-Dummad Noé-ebo-igar-mesisad
Bab-Dummad Noéʼgi, degi, e-masmalagi ise-nued binsasad. Weyob ega sogsad: “Mimmigan-bukidar be nikumar, we-napneggi dula be omelomar, bela we-napneg-ugakaase ambikumar.
Bela we-napneggi ibmar-dula-gudidimalad be-dobedba bemar-asabin gwakidmaloed:
”Bela ibmar-dulamalad, degi, gagan-araragana-sunna-gullemalad sunna bemar gunmaloed. Ani an bela bega uknaid.
”San-abebiid, melle be gunmalo. Ar abegi burba-dulagued danikid.
Ar ibmar-durgan be-oburgwisale, an we-ibdurgan oburgwemogoed. Dule, dule-oburgwismogale, amba oburgwilemogoed.
”Bemardi mimmigan-bukidar nikumar. Be-mimmigan we-napneggi mergumai gusun.”
Bab-Dummad Noéʼga, degi, e-masmalaga sogdebalid:
“Nabir, ani an bemarbo, degi, be-waganmarbo an igar mesoed.
Degine, bela ibmar-dulamalad bemarba ur-dummadyagi-bukwa-ainisad:
”Bela we-ibmar-durgan-we-napneggi-bukmaladbo an igar mesoed.
An-bemar-ebo-igar-mesoedi gwen gwagosulid: Bela dulemar, degine, bela ibmar-durgan muusailagi bar an ogilogosulid. We-napneg obelogega bar muusaila murosulid.
”An bemar-ebo, degine, an bela ibmar-durganbo-igar-mesnaidi, degisadegu maiguoed. A-e-wilubgan weyob maiguoed: Sue maiguoed.
Mogir-imbaba an sue-mesoedi, we-napnegbo an igar-mesoed-e-wilubga guoed.
We-napneggi mogirmar-gutumakalile, an-sue mogir-imbaba megnonikoed.
Geb an nue-ebinsaoed, an bemarbo, degi, bela ibmar-durganbo igar mesisad. Bela ibmar-dulamalad-ogilogega, baid-muusaila-weyobid bar murosulid.
Mogir-imbaba sue megnonikile, an dakoed. Agi, ani, Bab-Dummad, bela dulemarbo, degine, bela ibmar-durgan-we-napneggi-bukmaladbo degisadegu-igar-mesisad an ebinsaoed.
”We-napneggi bela dulemarbo, degi, ibmar-durganbo an igar-mesisadi, sue, e-wilubga guoed.” Deyob Bab-Dummad Noéʼga ibmar sogsad.
Noé-mumgusad
Noé-machimala ur-dummadyaba-nosmaladi, wemardo: Sem, Cam, Jafet. Camʼde, Canaán-e-babad.
Wemar-warbaagwad Noé-masmala gumalad. We-napneggi dulemar-bukmalad, belagwapa wemargi danimalad.
Noé napagi arbadgua, uva digsad.
Ibagwengi, Noé vino gobsagu, mumgusad. Noé e-dordonegyaba uka-swiri meremai gusad.
Canaán-e-bab-Cam, e-bab-Noé uka-swiri-mai-daksagu, nodegusad. E-iamar-warbogwad-magaba-gwichidga sogdapid.

Geb degi, Sem, Jafet-ebo e-bab-edugega mor-dummad amismalad. Geb gukinba mor-dummad-gani sorsik-sorsik nadegusmalad. Baidsik ataknadapi gusmalad, adi, mer e-bab uka-swiri-maid dakegar. Geb a-mor-dummadgi e-bab-edusmalad.
Noé nue-wibamasgu, atakalid. E-machi-bipigwad igi e-imaksa deyob, wisgusgu sogded:
Geb degi, Noé sogdebalid:

content.text: Bab-Dummad, Jafet-neg gatik nasgumai imakena gadin.

content: Muusaila-mulusad-sorba, Noé amba birga-dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulabo-gakambe (350) dula-gudii gusad.
Degisoggu, Noé, birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gaka dulabo-gakambe-nikadgi (950) burgwenonikid.
